_info.description: List of transaction categories and optional parent→child hierarchy for budget tracking
usage: Customize this list to match your personal budgeting needs
The system learns merchant categorizations from your manual corrections
LLM uses these categories when auto-categorizing new merchants
Add or remove categories as needed - just edit both 'categories' and 'subcategories'
tips: Keep category names clear and specific
Subcategories must appear in BOTH the 'categories' flat list AND the 'subcategories' mapping
Parent categories (Transportation, Utilities) still work as catch-all for anything unspecific
The dashboard automatically rolls subcategories up to their parent in pie charts and tables
The system is case-sensitive - 'Groceries' and 'groceries' are different
